_comment: Eight NEW custom fields. Use REST POST /rest/api/3/field once per item. searcherKey is the default for the chosen type — adjust if your instance prefers different searchers. After creation, options for selectlist fields must be added via POST /rest/api/3/field/{fieldId}/context/{contextId}/option (see field_options.json).
_naming_convention: DP prefix groups them in admin UI; underscore-prefixed key suggested via description tag

items.name: DP Value Stream Destination
items.description: dp_value_stream_destination · Single-select · 10 Value Streams (5 ITBA + 4 CS DVS + 1 Enabling). Filled by Requester at intake.

items.name: DP Sponsor
items.description: dp_sponsor · User picker · mandatory at intake. Person who agrees to be accountable for outcome.

items.name: DP Run / Grow / Transform
items.description: dp_run_grow_transform · Single-select · Strategic lens · separate from Type taxonomy.

items.name: DP Pain Score
items.description: dp_pain_score · Number · READ-ONLY · auto-computed by automation A4. ITBA: (BV·OPCOmult·0.45 + UX·0.30 + Safety·0.25)/Effort. CS: (BV·OPCOmult·0.40 + UX·0.60)/Effort.

items.name: DP UX Score
items.description: dp_ux_score · Number 1–5 · scored by PM at Analyzing.

items.name: DP OPCO Multiplier
items.description: dp_opco_multiplier · Number · READ-ONLY · auto-set by A4: 1.0 (single OpCo), 1.3 (2–4 OpCos), 1.6 (all 5+ OpCos).

items.name: DP Concept Prototype
items.description: dp_concept_prototype · Text/URL · attachment-style link · required for Transform-class items.

items.name: DP Class of Service
items.description: dp_class_of_service · Single-select · Standard · Fixed-Date · Expedite · Intangible. Drives swim-lane on boards. Set by automations A2/A3 or by PM at Reviewing.
